text.value: You are thinking about handing my team and me a serious amount of money, and you should know exactly what you get for it before you ever talk to us. So here is the whole thing, start to finish, in order, in plain words, as if you have never seen a system like this. Most people have not. None of it is new. Nobody ever sat down and explained it to you. Take your time with it.

text.label: Text: The first trap.
text.value: The first trap.

text.label: Text: You built an audience and you have nothing to sell them. Peo
text.value: You built an audience and you have nothing to sell them. People watch you, comment, share your videos and tell you that you changed how they think. Then they go and buy from somebody else, because you never gave them anything to buy. You have 5,000, 10,000, maybe 50,000 followers, and your income does not look anything like those numbers. That is the most common spot we see.

text.label: Text: The second trap.
text.value: The second trap.

text.label: Text: You do have something to sell. A program, a course, a book,
text.value: You do have something to sell. A program, a course, a book, a seat in your coaching group. It sells, but only when you personally answer the message, get on the call and chase the person who went quiet. So your income is tied to how many conversations you can hold in a day. On a busy week you sell. On a week you are sick, traveling or just tired, you do not.

text.label: Text: The same problem.
text.value: The same problem.

text.label: Text: In both cases you have attention and no system behind it. Ge
text.value: In both cases you have attention and no system behind it. Getting people to pay attention is the hard part, and you already did it. What is missing is the plain business machinery that takes a person from watching you to paying you. Nobody taught you that part, because most of what gets taught about building an audience stops at the audience. That missing part is what my team and I build.

text.value: For a long time I had a hard time with a simple question. When somebody asked me what I do for a living, I would start listing things. Websites. Systems. AI employees. All of it true, and none of it the answer. I finally have the answer. My team and I are a modern day talent agency. We take coaches, authors, speakers and influencers and show them how to make money with what they know and the attention they already have.

text.label: Text: The whole model.
text.value: The whole model.

text.label: Text: Here is the whole business in one line. Attention plus your
text.value: Here is the whole business in one line. Attention plus your product equals dollars. You take attention that costs you nothing, you put something in front of it that a person can buy, and you have a system that walks them from one to the other. None of this is new. It is how every business that ever advertised has worked. All I am adding is the order to do it in, and the people to build it.

text.label: Text: Attention.
text.value: Attention.

text.label: Text: The social platforms are free stages. So is a podcast, once
text.value: The social platforms are free stages. So is a podcast, once the technical setup is done for you. Reaching this many people used to cost real money, and today it takes a phone. You already know how to do this part. What changes is the job we give that attention. Right now most of what you put out has no job at all. It gets watched, it gets liked, and it ends there. With us, every video, clip and episode gets one job, which is sending people to your website.

text.label: Text: Your Product.
text.value: Your Product.

text.label: Text: This is the piece most people in your seat are missing. A pr
text.value: This is the piece most people in your seat are missing. A product is simply what you know, packaged so a stranger can buy it without you being in the room. It can be an e-book, a program, a course, a paid group or a day of your time. If you already have one, we build the system around it. If you do not, we package it with you, starting with your own e-book.

text.label: Text: Dollars.
text.value: Dollars.

text.label: Text: Dollars are what happens in between, and it is slower than p
text.value: Dollars are what happens in between, and it is slower than people think. Almost nobody buys the first time they see you. They need to see and hear from you seven to ten times before they trust you enough to pay. Somebody has to answer them, follow up, show them proof and come back around when they go quiet. That in-between work is the Revenue Engine.

text.label: Text: Why all three.
text.value: Why all three.

text.label: Text: Take away any one piece and the math stops working. Attentio
text.value: Take away any one piece and the math stops working. Attention with no product is a crowd. A product with no attention is a secret. Attention and a product with nothing connecting them is what most coaches, authors and influencers have right now. You are probably closer than you think. You are missing pieces, not starting over.

text.label: Pull line
text.value: Attention with no product is a crowd. A product with no attention is a secret.
